Leo and Libra compatibility

How Leo (Simha) and Libra (Tula) are traditionally said to get on, and the reasons behind it.

At a glance

Elements
Fire and Air
Modes
Fixed (sthira) and Cardinal (chara)
Ruling planets
Sun and Venus
Place in the zodiac
3/11 from each other
Graha Maitri (Guna Milan)
0 of 5 points
Bhakoot (Guna Milan)
7 of 7 points
Sign-level view
Mixed

Leo horoscope · Libra horoscope

The elements: Fire and Air

Leo is Fire and Libra is Air, a pairing the tradition counts as complementary: air feeds fire. Libra brings ideas and perspective, Leo brings drive, and together they tend to keep each other moving.

Temperament

Libra is a cardinal sign that starts things, Leo a fixed sign that sees them through. The tradition sees a natural division of work in that, as long as Libra does not push for change faster than Leo is willing to move.

The ruling planets

Leo is ruled by the Sun and Libra by Venus. In the natural friendship of the planets, the Sun counts Venus as an enemy, and Venus counts the Sun as an enemy. That gives this pair 0 of 5 points in Graha Maitri. Mutual enmity is the lowest this koota gives. It is one factor of many, and the tradition looks to the rest of both charts before drawing any conclusion.

Their place in the zodiac

Counted from Leo, Libra is the third sign; counted from Libra, Leo is the eleventh. In Bhakoot this is a 3/11 placement. It scores the full 7 points: the tradition sees the two signs as supporting each other's wellbeing and prosperity.

What each brings

Leo is traditionally said to bring warmth, generosity, loyalty and a sense of fun to a relationship, and to need appreciation, respect and a partner who is proud of them. Libra is said to bring fairness, charm and a real wish for partnership, and to need harmony, balance and decisions that are made together. The pair does well when each gives what the other needs, rather than what they would want themselves.

What signs can and cannot tell you

Everything on this page is the traditional sign-level view. In Guna Milan, Graha Maitri and Bhakoot are read from the two Moon signs (rashi), which need birth times, and they are only two of the eight kootas: the others come from the nakshatras. Two people of the same pair of signs can have very different charts, so a real match is judged from both full birth charts.

Frequently asked

Common questions

Are Leo and Libra compatible?

At the level of signs the traditional reading is: mixed. Their Guna Milan points from the two sign-based kootas are 0 of 5 for Graha Maitri and 7 of 7 for Bhakoot. Signs are only a starting point; a full kundli matching of both birth charts is what decides.

Should I use my sun sign or my Moon sign here?

Guna Milan uses the Moon sign (rashi), which needs your birth time. The element and temperament notes are often read for the sun sign too, but the Graha Maitri and Bhakoot points only apply to the Moon signs.

Does it matter which partner is Leo and which is Libra?

Not for anything on this page: elements, temperament, Graha Maitri and Bhakoot read the same both ways. Some other kootas of Guna Milan, such as Varna and Vashya, do look at who is the bride and who is the groom.
